How long does it take to get to the Moon from Earth? What about Mars or Jupiter?
 
As with most things in life, the answer is: it depends!
 
Speed is only one factor. Travel times also depend on distance, fuel, physics, and clever trajectory planning. From quick trips to the Moon to years-long voyages to the outer planets, every mission follows a unique path. Orbital dynamics expert Brent Barbee breaks down what it really takes to travel through space.
